## EA Media Tools 1.2.0 — ea-video

### Audio-library workflows

- Process audio files individually or scan artist and album folders recursively.
- Streaming uses Opus at 96 kbps, or 128 kbps for surround downmixes. Archive uses libfdk_aac at 224 kbps, or 256 kbps for downmixes.
- Converted libraries retain relative folders, original basenames, and matching `.lrc` lyric files under `converted`.
- Optional ReplayGain normalization runs rsgain once after the entire audio queue succeeds, never after a failed or cancelled batch.

### Music-video conversion

- Short videos with attached artwork automatically use the focused Music Video preset.
- The primary video is encoded while attached cover artwork is copied into the finished file.
- Metadata is preserved, smart naming is disabled, 4K-only scaling uses `2960:-2`, and embedded CEA-608/708 captions are checked automatically with CCExtractor.

### Runtime, settings, and updates

- The Stable Jellyfin FFmpeg and Hardware Acceleration switches are toggleable and persist between launches.
- Turning hardware acceleration off uses CPU video encoding and decoding.
- Splash messages now group runtime work into verification and loading stages.
- Windows updates remove obsolete app versions and legacy runtime libraries while preserving user configuration.

### Validation

- Lint, native and compatibility TypeScript checks, 34 unit tests, and production packaging.
- Regression coverage verifies cover-art stream mapping and prevents rsgain from running before full queue success.

[Review all changes since v1.1.0](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0).
